coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors instead of immediately marking a file and the overall package as inconclusive.
